firm_data.firm_description: Norm Law is an AI-native law firm built for global institutional clients. The firm uses AI agents designed by legal engineers to produce first-draft outputs for legal tasks.
notable_facts: Norm Law is powered by Norm Ai.
Blackstone has invested in Norm Ai and collaborates with Norm Law.
Norm Law focuses on financial services and highly regulated clients.
technology_signals: Uses AI agents for legal tasks

ai_contact.ai_notes: Norm Law utilizes AI agents developed by Norm Ai, leveraging legal engineers to embed legal expertise into these agents. Ben Lawsky, Troy A. Paredes, Tom Glocer, and Dan Berkovitz are on the Legal AI Committee.
